response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT a.translink, t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.peercorr > 0.149 AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.translink, t.ordertypedist) SELECT translink, ordertypedist, matched_count, matched_count * 1.0 / SUM(matched_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS fraction FROM counts ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10;
